upstreamCatalog.head: 0f14c26c6ae4b28771d984c32e8d1fd79c7929ee
upstreamCatalog.relationship: This inventory catalog is the current fail-closed surface-to-protocol index. Closed draft PR #23185 is retained only as a design reference for a richer provider conformance catalog; it is not merged code, evidence, or a required stack.

externalServices.missingMockReason: Redis test behavior is still selected inside the runtime process rather than owned by a resettable external service mock.

rules.unresolvedDependencyReason: The route dependency must be attributed from its implementation imports before it can be called local or assigned an external protocol.

externalServices.missingMockReason: PGlite is an in-process adapter, not a separately controlled external PostgreSQL protocol service with resettable operations.

externalServices.protocol: Stripe billing, checkout, and webhook APIs
externalServices.missingMockReason: No external Stripe checkout, webhook, and billing fixture is owned by the synthetic-world stack.

rules.noExternalServiceReason: The public locale read is served directly from the booted Cloud API without an external provider call.

externalServices.missingMockReason: The static-read fixture does not own the mutation and lifecycle operations exposed by the control-plane service boundary.

externalServices.protocol: Discord REST, Gateway, and interaction webhook protocols
externalServices.missingMockReason: The HTTP fixture returns the live Discord Gateway URL and does not own a controlled Gateway WebSocket session or event stream.
No resettable Kubernetes discovery service is registered for the Discord gateway production client.

externalServices.protocol: WhatsApp Cloud Graph API and webhook protocol
externalServices.missingMockReason: The fixture owns outbound message POSTs only and does not register the inbound webhook boundary used by the gateway service.

externalServices.protocol: Twilio Messages REST and webhook protocol
externalServices.missingMockReason: The fixture owns outbound REST calls only and does not register the inbound Twilio webhook boundary used by the gateway service.

externalServices.protocol: Blooio messaging REST and webhook protocol
externalServices.missingMockReason: No resettable Blooio production-client mock is registered for gateway delivery and webhook behavior.

externalServices.protocol: Kubernetes secrets and service discovery APIs
externalServices.missingMockReason: No resettable Kubernetes API service owns the webhook gateway secret and discovery fixtures.
No resettable external Kubernetes API service is registered for operator reconciliation scenarios.
Redis test behavior remains process-selected and has no separately controlled synthetic-world service.
The proxy forwards caller-controlled methods and paths, while the fixture owns only a narrow Messages and models subset.

externalServices.protocol: Configured shared Anthropic proxy health HTTP endpoint
externalServices.missingMockReason: The status surfaces can fetch the configured shared proxy health endpoint, which the Anthropic Messages fixture does not own.
The text-family handlers can invoke the production claude CLI, which the HTTP Mockoon fixture cannot own or reset.

externalServices.protocol: Browser workspace HTTP and automation protocol
externalServices.missingMockReason: The declared browser-automation fixture has no protocol endpoint contract and cannot own this boundary.

rules.unresolvedDependencyReason: Browser bridge management is process-local but may dispatch a runtime-selected text model to interpret missing arguments; provider attribution is not yet bound to this surface.

externalServices.missingMockReason: The Calendar fixture omits watch, stop-channel, and other production operations used by the Calendar service boundary.
No resettable Microsoft Graph Calendar protocol fixture is registered for calendar actions and services.
No controlled Apple EventKit calendar bridge fixture is registered for calendar actions and services.

externalServices.protocol: RFC 5545 ICS feed over guarded HTTP
externalServices.missingMockReason: No resettable external ICS feed service owns conditional fetch and feed mutation scenarios.
The fixture does not own provider-originated webhook ingress, watch and stop lifecycle calls, and the complete refetch path.

rules.noExternalServiceReason: These exact Calendar registrations expose local entity state, schema migration, or rendering without invoking a provider protocol.

rules.unresolvedDependencyReason: Discord surfaces span REST, Gateway WebSocket, OAuth, local RPC/IPC, setup, and data-only services; each implementation must be attributed explicitly before external protocol ownership is claimed.

externalServices.protocol: Browser workspace and Discord web-app automation protocol
externalServices.missingMockReason: No resettable browser-workspace fixture owns Discord web-app probing, search, and delivery-status behavior.

externalServices.protocol: DoorDash consumer ordering through the configured MCP tool protocol
externalServices.missingMockReason: No resettable DoorDash MCP protocol service is registered in the synthetic-world stack.

externalServices.protocol: Dropbox OAuth, metadata, and content APIs
externalServices.missingMockReason: No resettable Dropbox OAuth and content production-client mock is registered.

rules.unresolvedDependencyReason: Eliza Cloud surfaces span authenticated routes, providers, events, models, and local services; the two Google mock endpoints do not prove the package-wide protocol boundary.

externalServices.missingMockReason: The handler delegates to a runtime-selected provider; no single resettable wire mock owns every selectable provider.

externalServices.protocol: Browser workspace HTTP and automation protocol
externalServices.missingMockReason: The declared browser-automation fixture has no protocol endpoint contract and cannot own this boundary.
No resettable Fish Audio production-client mock is registered.

externalServices.protocol: GitHub REST, OAuth 2.0, and webhook protocols
externalServices.missingMockReason: The declared github-api fixture has no protocol endpoint contract and cannot own this boundary.
The Google Workspace mock does not implement the production Gemini model protocol.

externalServices.protocol: Google Chat v1 REST, media upload, service-account auth, and inbound event protocol
externalServices.missingMockReason: The Google fixture has no chat.googleapis.com operations, upload endpoints, or inbound Google Chat event transport.

externalServices.protocol: Google Workspace Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Meet, People, and OAuth APIs
externalServices.missingMockReason: The Google fixture owns only a Gmail and Calendar subset and omits Drive, Meet, People, watch, stop, and other service operations.

externalServices.protocol: iMessage bridge command and event protocol
externalServices.missingMockReason: The declared imessage-bridge fixture has no protocol endpoint contract and cannot own this boundary.

externalServices.protocol: Meta Instagram Graph API and webhooks
externalServices.missingMockReason: No resettable Instagram production-client and webhook mock is registered.
The generic GraphQL response does not implement the production viewer, team, and issue query and mutation contracts.
No resettable Google Places and Routes production-client mock is registered.
No resettable Matrix homeserver mock is registered.
MCP servers are runtime-selected and no canonical resettable MCP server fixture owns this provider.

externalServices.protocol: Notion OAuth and workspace REST API
externalServices.missingMockReason: The fixture omits OAuth, page reads, block-child reads, and other production Notion service operations.
The OpenAI fixture does not register the Responses API operation used by the research model handler.

rules.noExternalServiceReason: The exact tokenizer handlers run offline through js-tiktoken and never call the OpenAI API.

externalServices.protocol: elizaOS plugin registry HTTP and package metadata protocols
externalServices.missingMockReason: No resettable production-client registry upstream mock is registered.

externalServices.protocol: Slack Web API, Events API, and OAuth 2.0
externalServices.missingMockReason: The HTTP fixture omits Socket Mode WebSocket ingress and the full Web API operation set used by the Slack service.
The fixture owns profile and currently-playing reads only, not the OAuth and playback mutation operations exposed by the action boundary.
No resettable external TaskMarket production-client service owns the scenario fixtures.

externalServices.protocol: Telegram Bot API and webhook protocol
externalServices.missingMockReason: The fixture omits getChat, forum-topic and pin operations, media sends, reactions, and full Telegraf launch and lifecycle behavior.

externalServices.protocol: GitHub Releases API and binary download transport
externalServices.missingMockReason: No resettable GitHub release and binary-download mock is registered for video tooling.

rules.noExternalServiceReason: These exact Vision registrations use local capture, renderer bridge, and rendering state without directly dispatching a provider protocol.

rules.unresolvedDependencyReason: Vision execution dispatches runtime-selected image-description and transcription models plus optional native detectors; the selected provider boundary must be attributed before mock ownership is claimed.
Wallet registrations mix blockchain RPC, protocol-specific indexers, RSS, hosted trading, and process-local state; each surface requires call-path attribution before mock ownership can be claimed.

rules.noExternalServiceReason: The exact UserLpProfileService registration owns an in-memory profile map and invokes no external protocol.

externalServices.missingMockReason: No resettable Tavily production-client service is registered for deterministic search scenarios.

externalServices.protocol: WeChat messaging API and event protocol
externalServices.missingMockReason: No resettable WeChat production-client mock is registered.

externalServices.protocol: WhatsApp Cloud API, webhook, and Baileys transport protocols
externalServices.missingMockReason: The available HTTP fixture owns outbound message POSTs only and does not register the inbound webhook or Baileys transport used by these surfaces.

externalServices.protocol: X API v2, OAuth 2.0, and direct-message protocol
externalServices.missingMockReason: The partial fixture omits profile lookup, full timelines, search, delete, like, unlike, retweet, unretweet, and OAuth session operations.
No resettable Z.AI production-client mock is registered.
No resettable production-client Ollama server mock is registered.

rules.noExternalServiceReason: The Notes action mutates the agent-local NotesService state and does not call an external provider protocol.
